filling: Hey Dolores, good morning! I hope you're having a great start to your day.
Good morning, Maeve! I'm just getting ready for work. I hope your day is going well too.
That sounds good! I'm heading out to work soon too. I'll see you at Hobbs Cafe.
See you at Hobbs Cafe, Maeve! Have a great day.
